verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents and exposes a live, auth-gated REST API (airbyte-docs-3/17/18, airbyte-probe-rt-3), which is the kind of API that is normally backed by an OpenAPI spec, but the evidence pack contains an explicit probe showing that common OpenAPI/Swagger spec paths on docs.airbyte.com all return 404, and no citation confirms a working downloadable machine-readable spec URL. Missing for 10: a confirmed, reachable OpenAPI/Swagger JSON file link and independent corroboration that AI agents can programmatically fetch it.
